title: "ISOPlot builder"
description: "Compose a grouped figure layer by layer."
date: 2026-01-06
categories: [ISOPlot, grouping]
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-isoplot-builder
#| fig-alt: "Layered ISOPlot comparing four locations"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import soundscapy as sspy

data = pd.read_csv("../../assets/DemoData.csv")

places = ["CamdenTown", "PancrasLock", "RegentsParkJapan", "RegentsParkFields"]
subset = data[data["LocationID"].isin(places)]

(
    sspy.ISOPlot(
        data=subset,
        title="Layered ISOPlot",
        hue="LocationID",
        palette="husl",
    )
    .create_subplots()
    .add_scatter()
    .add_simple_density(fill=False)
    .style(diagonal_lines=True, legend_loc="lower left")
)
plt.show()
```
